name: Lyell and Mt Read Blvd Shopping Center
summary: Lyell and Mt Read Blvd Shopping Center is a well-established retail destination in northwest Rochester, offering a diverse mix of national retailers, local boutiques, dining options, and essential services. With its clean facilities, friendly atmosphere, and convenient location along Mount Read Boulevard, the center provides a practical yet enjoyable shopping experience for the local community.
demographics: Lyell and Mt Read Blvd Shopping Center serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in Rochester's northwest corridor, drawing primarily from working families and value-conscious shoppers within a 3-5 mile radius. The trade area encompasses a mix of suburban residential neighborhoods with household incomes ranging from $35,000 to $65,000, including young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services. Typical visitors prioritize practical shopping needs over luxury experiences, with strong demand for grocery, pharmacy, and essential services alongside affordable dining options.
description: Lyell and Mt Read Blvd Shopping Center has served as a cornerstone retail destination in Rochester's northwest community for decades, providing convenient access to a diverse mix of shopping and dining options along the busy Mount Read Boulevard corridor. Located at 729 Mount Read Boulevard, this well-established shopping center combines national retailers with local boutiques, creating a vibrant marketplace that caters to the everyday needs of Rochester residents. Customer reviews consistently praise the center's variety of stores, from trendy clothing boutiques and electronics retailers to cozy cafes and a beloved bookstore with a comfortable reading nook, making it an ideal destination for both quick errands and leisurely afternoon shopping trips. The center features a popular food court with diverse dining options, including a highly-rated taco restaurant, providing shoppers with convenient meal choices during their visits. With clean, well-maintained facilities, friendly staff throughout the property, and ample parking, Lyell and Mt Read Blvd Shopping Center continues to attract loyal customers who appreciate its accessible location, welcoming atmosphere, and the perfect blend of practical retail services and specialty shops that make each visit both productive and enjoyable.
